## PRB1.7. Investments {#prb1.7.-investments .Heading-2-ER}

- Slovenia Control planned a total asset value for new investments in RP4 of 27.1M€2022, of which 22.1% relates to new major investments. Slovenia Control planned 1 new major investment for RP4, which has not yet started.

- In 2025, Slovenia Control underspent -0.04M€2022 (-100.0%) in costs related to new major investments. This is attributable to a delay of one year compared to plan.

- According to the reporting tables, Slovenia Control overspent +0.1M€2022 (+1.6%) in costs related to investments in 2025.

- Slovenia Control reported no funding from Union assistance programmes in 2025.
